network_policy: Only fixed reviewed repository hosts; contained URLs never visited. No dataset code or HTML executed.

datasets.name: SpaPhish
datasets.validation_scope: Spanish-only anonymized author-inbox emails in SpaPhish v5. Does not validate English email predictions or deployment prevalence; source/campaign and collection-era limitations remain.
datasets.attribution: Bustio-Martinez, L., Fuentes-Fuentes, V., Agudelo-Fuentes, L. F., Herrera-Semenets, V., Llanes-Guilarte, D., Trujillo-Fernandez, F. A., Cardeña-Matamoros, C. A., Betancourt-Moreno, C. F., Haase-Hernandez, J. I., Molano-Jimenez, A. G., and van den Berg, J. (2026). SpaPhish: A Spanish Dataset for Phishing and Psychological Pattern Detection, version 5. Mendeley Data.
datasets.permission_basis: The dataset creators release their manually anonymized inbox collection under explicit CC BY 4.0; attribution and adaptation notice are retained.
datasets.collection_notes: Real Spanish personal/institutional inbox email from 2014–2025. Creator triple-annotator phishing/legitimate labeling; majority/adjudication; generic spam excluded. No original sender/campaign identifiers are public. SHA-256 row IDs and dates are retained for grouping/audits; technical and psychological annotations are excluded from model inputs.
datasets.changes: Selected subject/body only, joined as Subject: + subject + blank line + body; retained labels 0=legitimate/1=phishing; ignored derived/annotated features. Actual release delimiter is comma, contrary to README description.
limitations: Spanish only; this corpus does not validate English email inference.
Small author-inbox collection with collection/time/source bias; anonymization may introduce artifacts.
No sender or campaign grouping metadata; near-duplicate grouping must be computed from text before splitting.
Anonymization changes named entities; corpus benchmark calibration is not deployment prevalence calibration.

datasets.name: PhiUSIIL Phishing URL (Website)
datasets.validation_scope: Offline raw-URL benchmark from UCI PhiUSIIL with registrable-domain-disjoint evaluation. Strong HTTPS/path/length collection artifacts prohibit interpreting benchmark calibration or accuracy as arbitrary-URL field performance.
datasets.attribution: Prasad, A. and Chandra, S. (2024). PhiUSIIL Phishing URL (Website). UCI Machine Learning Repository. DOI:10.1016/j.cose.2023.103545.
datasets.permission_basis: UCI's original record explicitly licenses this dataset under CC BY 4.0; attribution and adaptation notice are retained.
datasets.collection_notes: 235,795 publisher-labeled URL/website records. Original label1=legitimate,0=phishing. Only raw URL strings and labels are used. Website source, page content, title, and all supplied numeric/reputation features are excluded; no destination is contacted.
datasets.changes: Selected URL and label only; inverted original labels to common0=legitimate,1=phishing. Remaining feature extraction and grouping happen offline from string only.
limitations: Source collection bias: every legitimate URL is HTTPS and at most58characters, with no non-root path in this snapshot. Benchmark scores can exploit these artifacts.
A historical corpus label does not establish current host safety or current maliciousness.
No known collection/campaign timestamps in the released URL subset; enforce registrable-domain disjoint splits and report source bias.
Exclude all webpage-derived features and corpus-label-derived probability columns to prevent unavailable-feature leakage.
